title: Enterprise SLA penalty simulator and legal-escalation gateway
creator: Asha Kapoor
description: Implement an interactive SLA penalty / credit simulator surfaced inside the sales contract redline flow and the Legal review intake. The simulator will: (1) show incremental price impact for alternative SLA liability/penalty bands and service credit formulas, (2) surface a one-page risk summary for Legal with pre-filled clause suggestions, and (3) gate or auto-route redlines to the appropriate legal tier based on configurable thresholds. This ticket covers the PM requirements, experiment design, acceptance criteria, and rollout plan for the MVP.
acceptance_criteria: Simulator UI available within contract redline review with three parametrized inputs: SLA target, penalty multiplier, and credit cap
Price delta calculation returns a clear tokenized estimate and percentage impact on ARR for the selected band
Automated risk summary generated (1-paragraph) and attached to the Legal intake form when penalty/credit exceeds configured thresholds
Routing rules support: auto-approve for low-risk band, routed to Legal Triage for medium, and routed to Legal Escalation queue for high
Telemetry emitted: time-in-flow for sales, # of auto-routes, avg price uplift accepted, and closing velocity for offers using simulator
Feature flagged and behind a pricing-experiment A/B cohort for 8 weeks with configuration available in Console
Design review signed off and engineering e2e test coverage for simulator calculations and routing decisions
Documentation: short playbook for Sales and Legal plus a runbook for on-call when routing fails
notes: Motivation: Sales reports long cycle times negotiating SLA credits and Legal backlog is spiky. A simulator reduces iteration between Sales and Legal by making economic trade-offs visible at the pre-sign stage.
Scope: MVP focuses on outbound enterprise offers (manual redlines) and the Legal intake form. Dedicated slot scheduling and contract automation (e-sign) are out of scope for this ticket.
Assumptions: pricing models available in pricing-service; we can compute ARR uplift deterministically from term and committed spend; Legal will accept a one-paragraph summary as prefill for intake.
Open questions: exact mapping of penalty/credit tiers to indemnity language; whether the simulator should suggest alternate SLA language or only present numeric impact

Success metrics: reduce average negotiation cycles by 25% for deals that use the simulator; reduce Legal Triage throughput by 15% in medium-risk band; non-inferior revenue realized (no increase in reversals due to under-estimated cost)
